import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Prepare data
X_train_text = train_df["text"].values
y_train = train_df["author"].values
X_test_text = test_df["text"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Split for validation (Stratified)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_text, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# --- Validation Phase (Hold-out) ---

# Word TF-IDF
word_vec_tr = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word", ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=50000, sublinear_tf=True
)
word_vec_tr.fit(X_tr)
X_tr_word = word_vec_tr.transform(X_tr)
X_val_word = word_vec_tr.transform(X_val)

# Char TF-IDF
char_vec_tr = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(1, 3), max_features=50000, sublinear_tf=True
)
char_vec_tr.fit(X_tr)
X_tr_char = char_vec_tr.transform(X_tr)
X_val_char = char_vec_tr.transform(X_val)

# Train Models
clf_word = LogisticRegression(
    multi_class="multinomial", solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
)
clf_word.fit(X_tr_word, y_tr)
y_val_pred_word = clf_word.predict_proba(X_val_word)

clf_char = LogisticRegression(
    multi_class="multinomial", solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
)
clf_char.fit(X_tr_char, y_tr)
y_val_pred_char = clf_char.predict_proba(X_val_char)

# Ensemble Validation Prediction
y_val_pred_ensemble = (y_val_pred_word + y_val_pred_char) / 2
val_loss = log_loss(y_val, y_val_pred_ensemble)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log Loss: {val_loss}")

# --- Submission Phase (Full Train) ---

# Re-fit vectorizers on full training data
word_vec_full = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word", ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=50000, sublinear_tf=True
)
word_vec_full.fit(X_train_text)
X_train_word_full = word_vec_full.transform(X_train_text)
X_test_word_full = word_vec_full.transform(X_test_text)

char_vec_full = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(1, 3), max_features=50000, sublinear_tf=True
)
char_vec_full.fit(X_train_text)
X_train_char_full = char_vec_full.transform(X_train_text)
X_test_char_full = char_vec_full.transform(X_test_text)

# Retrain Models on Full Data
clf_word_full = LogisticRegression(
    multi_class="multinomial", solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
)
clf_word_full.fit(X_train_word_full, y_train)
y_test_pred_word = clf_word_full.predict_proba(X_test_word_full)

clf_char_full = LogisticRegression(
    multi_class="multinomial", solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
)
clf_char_full.fit(X_train_char_full, y_train)
y_test_pred_char = clf_char_full.predict_proba(X_test_char_full)

# Ensemble Test Prediction
y_test_pred_ensemble = (y_test_pred_word + y_test_pred_char) / 2

# Prepare Submission
# Classes are sorted alphabetically by sklearn: EAP, HPL, MWS
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": y_test_pred_ensemble[:, 0],
        "HPL": y_test_pred_ensemble[:, 1],
        "MWS": y_test_pred_ensemble[:, 2],
    }
)

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
